about: Blender 5.2.2's equirectangular world lookup, measured by research/2026-10-stage19/blender/e6_environment/blender_env.py: a 256 x 128 'UV image' (R = u, G = v of each pixel centre, closest-pixel lookup) seen by tiny cameras along world directions; 'rotated' with the mapping node turned 90 degrees about Z. -X sits on the image's seam and +Z on its top edge, where the camera's 4 pixels straddle both sides: those two are left out. Rotated +Y looks up -X, the seam, as well: left out.
